helpSwitchA1: Bula tsebe ya gago ya Akhaonto mme o tobetse "Fetogela go Family". Ikwadiso ya gago ya jaanong e ntšhafadiwa mo karateng e e tshwanang, o sa e tsenye gape.
helpSwitchA2: Stripe e bala pharologano ya malatsi a a setseng a nako ya jaanong, ka jalo o duela pharologano fela.
helpChargeA1: Dituelo di bonala e le GADIT kgotsa GADIT.APP. Individual e ja $3.99 ka kgwedi kgotsa $39.99 ka ngwaga, mme Family e ja $5.99 ka kgwedi kgotsa $59 ka ngwaga. Kwa Iseraele tuelo e dirwa ka dishekele: ₪14.90 kgotsa ₪149 ya Individual, ₪19.90 kgotsa ₪199 ya Family. Diikwadiso tsa pele ga Diphalane 2026 di tswelela ka tlhwatlhwa e di simolotseng ka yone. Fa palo e sa tsamaisane, e ka nna ya tswa mo tirelong e nngwe.
helpCompareQ: Pharologano ke eng magareng ga Basic, Individual le Family?
helpCompareA1: Basic (mahala): go fitlha dipatlo tsa mafoko di le 10 ka letsatsi, ditlhaloso tsotlhe, dikai, Dikapolelo le dipolelo, Tshimologo ya lefoko le Bukana ya go fitlha mafoko a le 30.
helpCompareA2: Individual ($3.99 a month or $39.99 a year, ₪14.90 or ₪149 in Israel): motho a le mongwe, tsotlhe tsotlhe. Go leba mafoko go sa fele, setshwantsho sa bokao bongwe le bongwe, bokao jo bo siameng go tswa mo polelong, Every Word, Say it, kwala polelo ka karabo, dipolelo tse dingwe tsa sekai le dipotso ka lefoko lengwe le lengwe, lentswe la tlhago la go buisa, tiriso e e seng mo inthaneteng, metshameko, dipotso le dikgaisano tsa mafoko, le go ikatisa ka botlhale ka ipaakanyetso ya teko le dikteshene.
helpCompareA3: Family ($5.99 ka kgwedi kgotsa $59 ka ngwaga, ₪19.90 kgotsa ₪199 kwa Iseraele): sengwe le sengwe se se mo Individual mo baneng ba ba fitlhang go 5 le batsadi botlhe ba babedi, le Mokgwa wa bana, lefelo la ngwana mongwe le mongwe, lebota la batsadi le dikitsiso tsa mafoko, le Mopeleto.

pupSubject: Kafa o ka tlhatlosang akhaonto ya gago ya Gadit ka teng
pupBody:
Dumela {name},

Re a leboga go dirisa Gadit mo Android.

Akhaonto ya gago jaanong e mo leanong la Basic.

O ka bona didiriswa tsotlhe ka maano a Individual le Family.

## Family

Ya batsadi le bana.

Go fitlha bana ba le 5, mongwe le mongwe a na le Bukana ya gagwe, Mokgwa wa bana le lebota la batsadi.

## Individual

Ya motho a le mongwe.

Dipatlo kwa ntle ga selekanyo le didiriswa tsotlhe.

Omabedi a simolola ka malatsi a le 14 a mahala.

O ka khansela nako nngwe le nngwe pele teko e fela mme ga o kitla o duedisiwa sepe.

Fa o ikwadisa, app e tla ntšhafala ka bo yone.

Tsena fela ka akhaonto e e tshwanang.
